_doc: Model tiers and initial traits for every agent. The three tiers are the single place to change models: `bin/stack agents tiers --apply` renders tier -> model id into each agent's frontmatter (env vars ADVANCED_MODEL / MEDIUM_MODEL / LOW_MODEL override the ids). effort and maxTurns here are INITIAL traits (maxTurns is a moderate allowance, ~2x a typical demanding run: enough headroom that demanding work is not cut short before the learner has evidence, without inviting runaway loops): they are written only when missing or with --reset-traits; afterwards the Bayesian learner (config/learning.json) owns them. 'alias' is what callers pass as the per-call `model` override of the Agent tool, which accepts only aliases. 'context_window' is the tier model's context window in tokens (Claude Code 2.1.310 model table: 1,000,000 for claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5 and claude-haiku-5-5); autoCompactWindow can never exceed it. 'default_traits' apply to every agent without its own entry value: autoCompactWindow 600000 is the initial and the minimum (config/learning.json default_bounds), clamped to the tier's context_window.

delegator.why: routes every request; a wrong route costs more than any token saving

orchestrator.why: plans DAGs, judges gates, re-plans on failure

swarm-coordinator.why: sharding is mechanical but merge/dedup judgement needs the strongest model

mesh-router.why: many cheap routing rounds over a blackboard; Sonnet with more thinking

ensemble-assembler.why: choosing disciplines and roles decides the quality ceiling

concurrent-dispatcher.why: pure fan-out/fan-in bookkeeping, no content judgement

planner.why: acceptance criteria and dependencies must be right

plan-critic.why: finding what is missing needs depth

tester.why: good tests need reasoning about edge cases

quality-control.why: broad gate, mostly reading; strong model, moderate thinking

web-scraper.why: extraction to a schema from given pages

paper-researcher.why: faithful reading of methods, equations and results

file-summarizer.why: offload large output to disk, return a digest

computer-science-expert.why: proofs of complexity, correctness, distributed protocols

go-expert.why: idiomatic Go is well within Sonnet with extra thinking

java-expert.why: mainstream ecosystem, Sonnet with extra thinking

mathematics-expert.why: rigorous proofs; the one place max effort pays

graphic-design-expert.why: art direction and critique drive the image agents

image-generator.why: prompting, op selection and composition on the image server; review loop with visual-reviewer

image-editor.why: masked edits, cutouts, segmentation and fidelity checks on the image server

vector-artist.why: native SVG generation, tracing, hand edits, layering and PDF export

cross-domain-synthesizer.why: integrating experts into a higher-level answer

stack-tuner.why: operates the learner and reads posteriors

agent-architect.why: designs new agents/skills/workflows to the conventions

visual-reviewer.why: rubric scoring, defect localisation and convergent revision instructions for images and vectors; calibration across rounds needs the strongest model

python-expert.why: Python specialist (typing, asyncio, packaging with uv, pytest, profiling, FastAPI); well-trodden ecosystem, peers go/java/kotlin

typescript-expert.why: TypeScript and Node specialist (strict types, tsconfig/build, vitest, React, Node runtime); well-trodden ecosystem, peers go/java/kotlin

writing-project-builder.why: scaffolds, validates and indexes manuscript projects with manuscript.py; mechanical file work

fiction-writer.why: drafts and revises fiction chapters against outline, bible and style sheet; voice and canon judgment

manuscript-reviewer.why: developmental review and synthesis of copyedit/style reports; whole-book structural judgment

copy-editor.why: rule-based US English copyediting of chapters from prose_check.py candidates read in context

prose-stylist.why: line-level style analysis (avoid-prose families, show-not-tell, rhythm) with rewrite suggestions

chat-aide.why: real-time message checks: Sonnet keeps tone judgment sharp at low effort; no tools needed for a pasted draft
